0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 4-0 on the road, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Toronto Raptors (5-4, coming off a win, 6th in the East) in Memphis's 10th game of the season. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee, bruise), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness), while Toronto is without Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin, soreness). The Grizzlies lost both meetings with the Raptors in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
